components.name: Character Cell
components.description: The signature mark: an accent-tinted ruled square holding one character.

narrative.northStar: The Lexicon — a night dictionary: deep ink ground, a vermilion seal, brass figures, and a ruled character cell.
narrative.overview: A game HUD a household uses every day, drawn as a night dictionary. The page is deep ink and the language lives in a ruled character cell — a hairline square with faint cross guides. Colour is a role: seal vermilion for the forward action and the earned rank, jade for what grows, brass gold for earned numbers, and azure/violet/brass/ember as semantic data. Flat by construction: depth is a lightness step plus a 1px hairline, never a shadow. The app is entirely dark; there is no light surface.
keyCharacteristics: Flat deep-ink ground (#090d12 to #1a242f), no gradients, no shadows, no light surfaces
The character cell — a hairline square with faint cross guides — holds the studied character
Vermilion seal (#e2452b) for the forward action; brass gold (#eac168) for earned numbers
Ruled entries (1px rules) instead of a card grid; 3-5px radii
Mobile-first single column (max 42rem), six-tab bottom bar with drawn SVG icons

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: A surface carries exactly one accent. Set it with --accent (accentStyle(color)); tints and borders derive from it with color-mix. Two accents in one panel is a bug, not a flourish.

rules.name: The Cell Holds The Word Rule
rules.body: The character cell is reserved for language — the character or word under study. It is never a generic container.

rules.name: The Flat Colour Rule
rules.body: No gradients, no glows, no shadows, no glassmorphism. The energy budget is hue, not light.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Earned Rule
rules.body: If it is a number the player earned, it is set in the display serif with tabular figures. Sentences are sans.

rules.name: The Quiet Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy is never serif and never uppercase; uppercase is reserved for the tracked label.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth is a lightness step plus a hairline. If a surface seems to float, lower its fill instead of adding a shadow.

dos: Assign colour through --accent per surface, so tints and borders derive from one hue.
Set earned numbers in the display serif with tabular figures, brass gold for XP, streak, rank and currency.
Keep the character cell for language only, and the seal vermilion for the one forward action.
Convey depth with one lightness step plus a 1px hairline.
Keep colour semantic: jade grows, brass earns, azure is the academy, violet is support, ember is combat.
Draw icons — one stroke and weight — and reserve emoji for server-provided content.
Cap decorative transitions at 0.25s; bars may animate to 0.4s.
donts: Don't add gradients, glows, coloured drop shadows, or glassmorphism.
Don't introduce a light surface; the app is one dark room.
Don't put two accents in one panel or use gold as a fill behind body text.
Don't set body copy in the serif, or uppercase anything except the tracked label.
Don't use the character cell as a generic container, or the seal vermilion for anything but the forward action and earned ranks.
Don't reintroduce a card grid where a ruled entry belongs.
